title: A Face in the Crowd
description: A TV woman (Patricia Neal) turns Arkansas bum Lonesome Rhodes (Andy Griffith) into a homespun media hero rotten with power.

title: Patterns
description: A New York corporate boss (Everett Sloane) grooms an Ohio engineer (Van Heflin) for the No. 2 man's (Ed Begley) job.

title: Boorman and the Devil
description: Filmmaker John Boorman seizes the opportunity to direct "Exorcist II: The Heretic," but the movie's disappointing reception from critics and fans nearly ends his career. Includes interviews with Boorman and actresses Linda Blair and Louise Fletcher.

title: Exorcist II: The Heretic
description: Four years after an exorcism, another priest (Richard Burton) arrives to free a possessed young woman (Linda Blair).

title: Hope and Glory
description: A 9-year-old boy (Sebastian Rice Edwards) recalls life with his mother (Sarah Miles) and family in World War II England.

title: Point Blank
description: A ruthless crook seeks revenge against the partner who betrayed him and left him for dead on Alcatraz Island.

title: In My Country
description: An American reporter (Samuel L. Jackson) and an Afrikaans poet (Juliette Binoche) meet and fall in love while covering South Africa's Truth and Reconciliation Commission hearings.

title: Microscopic Mysteries
description: The life and death struggles of insects are viewed through a microscope.

title: The Green Slime
description: Two space-station astronauts (Robert Horton, Richard Jaeckel) destroy an asteroid, then face monsters formed from viscous cells.

title: The Haunted Strangler
description: The ghost of the long-dead Haymarket Strangler takes possession of a researcher bent on clearing the killer's name.

title: Batman and Robin
description:
S01 E15 — Batman Victorious
The Wizard's identity is revealed as he uses his invisibility to evade capture.

title: Calling Dr. Gillespie
description: Dr. Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore) lets his Dutch colleague (Philip Dorn) handle the case of a homicidal maniac.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Haredevil Hare
Bugs gets blasted into space and makes it all the way up to the moon.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Jumpin' Jupiter
Porky and Sylvester camp in the desert and encounter a space alien.

title: Funny Lady
description: Divorced from gambler Nicky Arnstein (Omar Sharif), Ziegfeld star Fanny Brice (Barbra Streisand) falls for Broadway showman Billy Rose (James Caan).

title: Giant
description: A cattleman (Rock Hudson) and his spoiled wife (Elizabeth Taylor) watch an upstart oilman (James Dean) try to take over Texas.

title: The Asphalt Jungle
description: Recently released from prison, Dix Handley gathers a team of small-time crooks to steal a fortune in jewels. The heist is a success until a stray bullet kills one of the men, and the rest of the gang let greed get the best of them.

title: Nights of Cabiria
description: An aging Roman streetwalker (Giulietta Masina) meets a movie star (Amedeo Nazzari) and a man (François Perier) who says he loves her.

title: Babette's Feast
description: An exiled Paris chef (Stéphane Audran) enlightens two pious Danish sisters who forsook romance and fame.

title: Crime Wave
description: Former jail mates make it difficult for a paroled man, hounded by a suspicious detective, to go straight.

title: S.O.B.
description: A suicidal Hollywood producer (Richard Mulligan) tries to save his flop, "Night Wind," by having the demure star (Julie Andrews) go topless.
A middle-aged pop-music composer (Dudley Moore) follows a nubile woman (Bo Derek) on her honeymoon to Puerto Vallarta.

title: A Fine Pair
description: A New York police captain (Rock Hudson) helps an Italian beauty (Claudia Cardinale) return some stolen jewels to a safe in Austria.

title: They Came to Rob Las Vegas
description: A blackjack dealer (Gary Lockwood), his girlfriend (Elke Sommer) and his gang make an armored car disappear in the desert.

title: Crime Wave
description: Former jail mates make it difficult for a paroled man, hounded by a suspicious detective, to go straight.

title: Lust for Life
description: Tormented Dutch painter Vincent van Gogh (Kirk Douglas) meets French painter Paul Gauguin (Anthony Quinn).

title: The Naked Kiss
description: A former prostitute discovers that her philanthropic fiancé is involved in perversion.

title: Dead Ringer
description: Edith (Bette Davis) kills Margaret, her twin, and takes her identity, fooling Edith's boyfriend (Karl Malden) but not Margaret's lover.

title: The Bad Seed
description: Odd fatal accidents lead a woman (Nancy Kelly) to realize that her 8-year-old daughter (Patty McCormack) was born to kill.

title: Back Street
description: Based on Fanny Hurst's classic novel of the star-crossed romance between a prominent married man and an Ohio farm woman.

title: King of Jazz
description: This lost film found in 1970 features dance numbers, pioneer special effects, animation, the Rhythm Boys with Bing Crosby.

title: Katana: The Oath of the Sword
description: Ambitious young Masao leaves his lover Hisa in Japan to study abroad at the University of California, Berkeley. Unable to cope, Hisa eventually marries another man.

title: Apart From You
description: Two geisha deal with life's hardships.

title: Three Colors: Red
description: Tapped phone lines connect a Swiss law student, a model (Irène Jacob) and an ex-judge (Jean-Louis Trintignant) who eavesdrops.

title: Camera Buff
description: A Polish factory worker (Jerzy Stuhr) embraces filmmaking after recording his daughter's birth.

title: Tugboat Annie
description: A tugboat captain (Marie Dressler) and her tipsy husband (Wallace Beery) see their son (Robert Young) go on to bigger things.

title: Emma
description: Children sue their former nanny (Marie Dressler) after their father (Jean Hersholt), whom she weds, leaves her his fortune.

title: Vanity Fair
description: A 19th-century story, now updated to the 1930s, tells of an irrepressible and intelligent Englishwoman who is determined to advance her position.

title: The Wet Parade
description: Alcohol and Prohibition catch up to the patriarchs (Walter Huston, Lewis Stone) of two families, North and South.

title: New Morals for Old
description: Proper parents have a son (Robert Young) who wants to go to Paris, and a daughter (Margaret Perry) in love with a married man.

title: Love Me Tonight
description: Mistaken for a baron, a singing Paris tailor (Maurice Chevalier) woos a princess (Jeanette MacDonald) at her castle.

title: Thirteen Women
description: Remembering the slights she suffered at the hands of her classmates, a young woman plans an unusual form of vengeance.

title: The Mask of Fu Manchu
description: Fiendish Fu forces archaeologists and a Scotland Yard inspector to the relics of Genghis Khan.

title: The Animal Kingdom
description: A publisher (Leslie Howard) marries a socialite (Myrna Loy) instead of the artist (Ann Harding) he loves.

title: The Thin Man
description: The recently divorced Gilbert discovers that his new girlfriend has stolen $50,000 and is carrying on with other men. Not long afterward, he disappears. Anxious to locate her father, Gilbert's daughter goes to private detective Nick Charles for help.

title: After the Thin Man
description: Urbane Nick and Nora Charles (William Powell, Myrna Loy) look for a cousin's missing husband and find murder.

title: Another Thin Man
description: Nick and Nora Charles (William Powell, Myrna Loy) visit a Long Island estate, where Nick drinks Scotch and solves murders.

title: Shadow of the Thin Man
description: Nick and Nora Charles solve racetrack-related murders with their 4-year-old son and dog, Asta.

title: The Thin Man Goes Home
description: Nick and Nora Charles (William Powell, Myrna Loy) visit his hometown, sober, and link art and corpses to a spy ring.

title: Song of the Thin Man
description: Nick and Nora Charles (William Powell, Myrna Loy) solve a floating-casino murder with a jazz clarinetist (Keenan Wynn).
